answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in harbor, verified in garden, and grove names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 50 submissions per epoch. Every extra alias adds 15 hours of verification and 11 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
